title: Taxonomy-Agnostic Neurosymbolic Grounding of Robot Kinematics
abstract: arXiv:2611.13850v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: While symbolic reasoning for task allocation requires grounding a robot's physical capabilities, standard Unified Robot Description Format (URDF) files provide only low-level kinematics without the formal semantic context needed for reasoning. We present URDF2Ontology, an automated, taxonomy-agnostic neurosymbolic framework that transforms raw URDF files into populated, grounded OWL ontologies. It leverages a Large Language Model (LLM) for targeted semantic reasoning, coupled with an iterative sequential graph-purging mechanism to prevent context window saturation. To process complex kinematic structures, it employs a morphology-aware dual-track architecture featuring a bottom-up Tree Track for branching assemblies and a top-down Chain Track for serial limbs. translated_title: 与分类体系无关的机器人运动学神经符号接地
translated_abstract: 虽然用于任务分配的符号推理需要对机器人的物理能力进行接地，但标准的统一机器人描述格式（URDF）文件仅提供低层运动学信息，缺乏推理所需的正式语义上下文。我们提出了URDF2Ontology，一个自动化的、与分类体系无关的神经符号框架，能够将原始URDF文件转换为填充完整且已接地的OWL本体。该框架利用大型语言模型（LLM）进行有针对性的语义推理，并结合迭代式顺序图清除机制以防止上下文窗口饱和。为了处理复杂的运动学结构，它采用了形态感知的双轨架构，包括用于分支组件的自底向上“树轨道”以及用于串联肢体的自顶向下“链轨道”。在神经符号护栏的引导下，该框架提取功能子图，并断言生成与任意用户提供的分类体系对齐的填充本体。
tldr: 该论文提出URDF2Ontology框架，利用LLM语义推理与形态感知的双轨架构，自动将原始URDF文件转换为与任意用户分类体系对齐的填充式OWL本体，为机器人物理能力的符号推理提供接地。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces URDF2Ontology, an automated taxonomy-agnostic neurosymbolic framework that leverages LLM-based semantic reasoning and a morphology-aware dual-track architecture to transform raw URDF files into populated OWL ontologies grounded in arbitrary user-provided taxonomies.
